notes.purpose: The Assistant's first tab: decisions an overnight review needs from the worker.

elements.name: Needs you tab and finding card
elements.shows: Tab label with a count and one finding card

states.shows: Tab "Needs you · 1"; card "INPUT NEEDED · OVERNIGHT REVIEW" with the question, a one-line reason, section and review time
Check, "You're up to date", "Your answer is saved in this preview. There are no other decisions waiting."

elements.logic: Findings and their counts live only inside the Assistant; Home and the section cards carry no badge. Answering a finding removes it from this tab in the same session.
elements.rule: The header entrance is a plain door: no count, no dot.

edge: The sample has one finding; a second, an empty review and a review in progress are not drawn.
issues: The review is simulated: no background agent is connected.

notes.purpose: One finding in full: the evidence, what is missing, and a field for the worker's answer.

elements.name: Evidence and answer
elements.shows: Scope line (section / unit / pen), the source note, what is missing, an answer field and Send clarification
elements.logic: The review quotes the source record and names the gap; it states that no movement record has been changed. The answer is free text, required, up to 500 characters.
elements.rule: Sending saves the answer in the session and adds "Movement clarification received" to Records. No live record is changed.

controls.does: Opens Home scoped to Gestation Unit 7

issues: Whether an answer is applied to the record, or only noted for a supervisor, is undecided (preview only).
"View Unit 7" is drawn as bare text, not as a button (see the filed broken item).

notes.purpose: The finding after the worker answered.

elements.name: Saved answer
elements.shows: "Your answer: <text>" with "Saved in this preview. No live record was changed."
elements.rule: The Send button and the answer field are removed once an answer is on file; there is no edit or undo.

issues: No way to edit or withdraw an answer.

notes.purpose: The Needs-you tab once nothing is waiting.

elements.name: Up-to-date state
elements.logic: Shown when the single sample finding has been answered; it does not mean no review has run.

notes.purpose: The Assistant's second tab: ask about the work, or start from a suggestion.

elements.name: Composer
elements.shows: Input and send at the foot of the page
elements.rule: Required, up to 1000 characters. Nothing is sent to an agent: the reply states that this is a preview.

edge: Context follows the scope the Assistant was opened from: the section, or the unit when one is selected.
issues: Conversations are simulated; the reply is fixed text.

notes.purpose: A question and the preview reply.

elements.name: Assistant reply
elements.at: This is a preview of the conversation entrance.
elements.shows: A fixed reply naming the current scope (the section or Unit N)
elements.logic: The reply restates the scope the Assistant was opened from and says no analysis or farm action has been performed.
elements.rule: The Assistant never performs a farm action and gives no medical recommendation in the study.
